case.summary: The real-time fraud model flagged transaction 3450629 ($100.09, online) with a moderate risk score of 0.57, while the customer profile exhibited high behavioral variance, including 16 distinct billing regions and 21 distinct devices. Evidence evaluated included the transaction's risk score, recent card activity showing a burst of online purchases, a generic device fingerprint treated as non-diagnostic, and similar historical cases that were cleared. Additional evidence was not requested as the pattern aligned with ambiguous single-purchase indicators. In accordance with card-not-present fraud guidelines (policies R1–R4), because a single unusual online purchase is ambiguous and the verdict assessed the transaction as likely legitimate (probability 0.15), the recommended action is to verify the transaction with the customer (`VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER`).
